This '''ship''' was an [[Ithullan ore hauler]] active in the [[Stenness Node]] in the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It was under the control of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gruna]]. In [[3999 BBY]], the ore hauler was [[Attack on the Ithullan ore hauler|attacked]] by [[Finhead Stonebone]]'s [[Finhead Stonebone's pirate gang|pirate gang]], but the ship was saved by local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]], [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']].
